question: By whose grace has the determination of the Kaula doctrine become known to the speaker?
premises: The knowledge concerns the determination of Kaula.
The cause of this knowledge is the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
inference: The speaker has come to know the Kaula determination through the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
